column1: # Complete unquoted value dialogue: reference 0x140664be0 / classic 0x140662600, value_type 0..32.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664c4b -> 0x141664828; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066266b -> 0x14165f5b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Society flourishes when law breakers are punished.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664c65 -> 0x141664800; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662685 -> 0x14165f630; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: One should always respect the law.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664cbc -> 0x1416647c8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406626dc -> 0x14165f538; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: No law can do justice to the complexity of life.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664cd6 -> 0x141664790; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406626f6 -> 0x14165f5e8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Nothing gives them the right to establish these laws.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664d32 -> 0x141664680; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662752 -> 0x14165fc00; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I consider laws to be more of a suggestion than anything.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664d4c -> 0x141664740; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066276c -> 0x14165fbb0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Rules are there to be bent, but they shouldn't be flouted thoughtlessly.

column2: value_type=LAW(0); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664d66 -> 0x1416646f8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662786 -> 0x14165f570; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some laws are just, while others were made to be broken.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664dcb -> 0x1416658f0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406627eb -> 0x14165fa90; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: One must always be loyal to their cause and the ones they serve.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664de5 -> 0x141665890; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662805 -> 0x14165fb50; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: How can society function without loyalty?  We must be able to have faith in each other.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664dff -> 0x1416646c0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066281f -> 0x14165fb18; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You must never forget true loyalty.  Repay it in full.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664e64 -> 0x141665730; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662884 -> 0x14165fa40; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Never lose yourself in loyalty.  You know what is best for yourself.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664e7e -> 0x141665810; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066289e -> 0x14165f9c0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The whole idea of loyalty is pointless.  Acting purely out of loyalty implies acting against one's own best interest.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664e98 -> 0x1416657d0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406628b8 -> 0x14165fad8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Don't serve anyone blindly.  You'll only get into trouble.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664ef4 -> 0x1416656c0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662914 -> 0x14165f870; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Consider your loyalties carefully, adhere to them while they last, and abandon them when you must.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664f0e -> 0x141665660; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066292e -> 0x14165f960; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You should only maintain loyalty so long as something more important is not at stake.

column2: value_type=LOYALTY(1); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664f28 -> 0x141665780; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662948 -> 0x14165f910; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Loyalty has value, but you should always keep the broader picture in mind.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664f8d -> 0x141665578; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406629ad -> 0x14165f838; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Family is the true bond that keeps society thriving.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664fa7 -> 0x141665610; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406629c7 -> 0x14165f7f0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You can always rely on your family when everything else falls away.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140664fc1 -> 0x1416655d8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406629e1 -> 0x14165f8d8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: How great it is to be surrounded by family!

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665026 -> 0x141665520; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662a46 -> 0x141660a70; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I hold the relationships I've forged myself over family ties I had no part in creating.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665040 -> 0x1416654e0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662a60 -> 0x14165f7b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We cannot choose our families, but we can choose to avoid them.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066505a -> 0x1416655b0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662a7a -> 0x14165f780; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I was always irritated by family.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406650ac -> 0x141665490; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662acc -> 0x1416609f0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You can't always rely on your family, but it's good to know somebody is there.

column2: value_type=FAMILY(2); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406650c6 -> 0x141665430; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662ae6 -> 0x141660ad0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Family is complicated and those ties be both a boon and a curse.  Sometimes both at once!

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066512b -> 0x141665c70; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662b4b -> 0x1416609b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: When all other bonds wither, friendship will remain.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665145 -> 0x141665d00; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662b65 -> 0x141660960; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Surround yourself with friends you can trust and you will be unstoppable.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066515f -> 0x141665cd0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662b7f -> 0x141660a40; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's nothing like a good friend.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406651c4 -> 0x141665c00; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662be4 -> 0x141660820; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Building friendships is a waste.  There is no bond that can withstand distance or a change of circumstance.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406651de -> 0x141665ba0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662bfe -> 0x141660900; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Friends are future enemies.  I don't see the difference.  People do as they must.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406651f8 -> 0x141665ca8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662c18 -> 0x1416608d0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Be careful of your so-called friends.

column2: value_type=FRIENDSHIP(3); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665212 -> 0x141665b40; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662c32 -> 0x141660890; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Friends are nice, but you should keep your priorities straight.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665277 -> 0x141665ae0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662c97 -> 0x141660730; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You can be powerful or powerless.  The choice is yours, until somebody makes it for you.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665291 -> 0x141665aa0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662cb1 -> 0x1416607e0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Power over others is the only true measure of worth.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406652ab -> 0x141665b80; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662ccb -> 0x1416607c8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Strive for power.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665302 -> 0x141665a68; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662d22 -> 0x1416606a8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It is abhorrent to seek power over other people.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066531c -> 0x141665a30; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662d3c -> 0x141660790; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's nothing admirable about bullying others.

column2: value_type=POWER(4); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665336 -> 0x1416659c0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662d56 -> 0x1416606e0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The struggle for power must be balanced by other considerations.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066539b -> 0x141665978; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662dbb -> 0x141660e60; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Everything is so much easier when you just tell the truth.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406653b5 -> 0x141665938; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662dd5 -> 0x141660f30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There is nothing so important that it is worth telling a lie.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406653cf -> 0x141665a08; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662def -> 0x141660f08; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You should always tell the truth.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665434 -> 0x141664f30; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662e54 -> 0x141660e10; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Don't think about the truth, whatever that is.  Just say what needs to be said.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066544e -> 0x141665030; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662e6e -> 0x141660d90; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Is there ever a time when honesty by itself overrides other considerations?  Say what is right, not what is true.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665468 -> 0x141664fc0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662e88 -> 0x141660ea0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There is no value in telling the truth thoughtlessly.  Consider the circumstances and say what is best.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406654c4 -> 0x141664ec0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662ee4 -> 0x141660c60; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Sometimes the blunt truth just does more damage.  Think about how the situation will unfold before you speak.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406654de -> 0x141664e60; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662efe -> 0x141660d30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It is best not to complicate your life with lies, sure, but the truth also has its problems.

column2: value_type=TRUTH(5); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406654f8 -> 0x141664f80; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662f18 -> 0x141660cf0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There are times when it is alright not to tell the whole truth.

column2: value_type=CUNNING(6); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665511 -> 0x141664df8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662f31 -> 0x141660cd0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I do admire a clever trap.

column2: value_type=CUNNING(6); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665530 -> 0x141664e18; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662f50 -> 0x141660bf0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's no value in all of this scheming I see these days.

column2: value_type=CUNNING(6); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066554a -> 0x141664da0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662f6a -> 0x141660c30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Be shrewd, but do not lose yourself in guile.

column2: value_type=ELOQUENCE(7); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406655a7 -> 0x141664d38; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662fc7 -> 0x141660bc0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I can appreciate the right turn of phrase.

column2: value_type=ELOQUENCE(7); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406655c1 -> 0x141664dd0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140662fe1 -> 0x141660b98; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I do admire a clever turn of phrase.

column2: value_type=ELOQUENCE(7); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665618 -> 0x141664cb8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663038 -> 0x141660b68; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: They are so full of all those big words.

column2: value_type=ELOQUENCE(7); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665632 -> 0x141664d68; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663052 -> 0x141660b30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Who are these mealy-mouthed cowards trying to impress?

column2: value_type=ELOQUENCE(7); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066564c -> 0x141664cf0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066306c -> 0x141660240; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There is a time for artful speech, and a time for blunt speech as well.

column2: value_type=FAIRNESS(8); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665665 -> 0x141664c60; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663085 -> 0x141660288; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Always deal fairly.

column2: value_type=FAIRNESS(8); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665684 -> 0x141664c78; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406630a4 -> 0x141660180; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Don't be afraid to do anything to get ahead in this world.

column2: value_type=FAIRNESS(8); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066569e -> 0x141665390; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406630be -> 0x1416601c0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Life isn't fair, and sometimes you have to do what you have to do, but working toward a balance isn't a bad thing.

column2: value_type=DECORUM(9); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406656bd -> 0x141665408; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406630dd -> 0x141660130; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Please maintain your dignity.

column2: value_type=DECORUM(9); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406656dc -> 0x1416652f8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406630fc -> 0x141660150; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: What do you care how I speak or how I live?

column2: value_type=DECORUM(9); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406656f6 -> 0x141665330; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663116 -> 0x1416600b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I can see a place for maintaining decorum, but it's exhausting to live that way.

column2: value_type=TRADITION(10); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665753 -> 0x1416652c8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663173 -> 0x141660040; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's admirable when the traditions are upheld.

column2: value_type=TRADITION(10); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066576d -> 0x1416652a0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066318d -> 0x141660108; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some things should never change.

column2: value_type=TRADITION(10); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406657c4 -> 0x141665278; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406631e4 -> 0x14165ffc0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We need to move beyond traditions.

column2: value_type=TRADITION(10); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406657de -> 0x141665240; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406631fe -> 0x141660070; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We need to find a better way than those of before.

column2: value_type=TRADITION(10); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406657f8 -> 0x1416651e0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663218 -> 0x14165fff0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some traditions are worth keeping, but we should consider their overall value.

column2: value_type=ARTWORK(11); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066584f -> 0x141665198; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066326f -> 0x14165ff98; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The creative impulse is so valuable.

column2: value_type=ARTWORK(11); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665869 -> 0x141665230; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663289 -> 0x14165ff88; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Art is life.

column2: value_type=ARTWORK(11); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406658c0 -> 0x141665120; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406632e0 -> 0x14165ff60; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Art?  More like wasted opportunity.

column2: value_type=ARTWORK(11); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406658da -> 0x1416651c0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406632fa -> 0x14165ff40; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: What's so special about art?

column2: value_type=ARTWORK(11); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406658f4 -> 0x141665150; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663314 -> 0x141660640; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Art is complicated.  I know what I like, but some I can do without.

column2: value_type=COOPERATION(12); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066590d -> 0x1416650a8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066332d -> 0x141660688; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We should all work together.

column2: value_type=COOPERATION(12); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066592c -> 0x1416650d0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066334c -> 0x141660570; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's better to work alone when possible, I think.  Cooperation breeds weakness.

column2: value_type=COOPERATION(12); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665946 -> 0x141666990; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663366 -> 0x1416605c0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You should think carefully before embarking on a joint enterprise, though there is some value in working together.

column2: value_type=INDEPENDENCE(13); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665965 -> 0x141666a08; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663385 -> 0x141660518; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I treasure my freedom.

column2: value_type=INDEPENDENCE(13); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665984 -> 0x141666910; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406633a4 -> 0x141660530; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Nobody is free, and it is pointless to act as if you are.

column2: value_type=INDEPENDENCE(13); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066599e -> 0x141666950; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406633be -> 0x1416604a8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Personal freedom must be tempered by other considerations.

column2: value_type=STOICISM(14); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406659bd -> 0x1416668b0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406633dd -> 0x1416604e8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: One should not complain or betray any feeling.

column2: value_type=STOICISM(14); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406659dc -> 0x1416668e0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406633fc -> 0x141660408; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Do not hide yourself behind an unfeeling mask.

column2: value_type=STOICISM(14); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406659f6 -> 0x141666820; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663416 -> 0x141660440; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There are times when it is best to keep your feelings to yourself, but I wouldn't want to force it.

column2: value_type=KNOWLEDGE(32); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665a15 -> 0x141666888; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663435 -> 0x1416603a8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The quest for knowledge never ends.

column2: value_type=KNOWLEDGE(32); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665a34 -> 0x141666790; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663454 -> 0x1416603d0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: All of that so-called knowledge doesn't mean a thing.

column2: value_type=KNOWLEDGE(32); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665a4e -> 0x1416667d0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066346e -> 0x141660330; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Knowledge can be useful, but it can also be pointless or even dangerous.

column2: value_type=INTROSPECTION(15); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665a6d -> 0x141666738; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066348d -> 0x141660380; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It is important to discover yourself.

column2: value_type=INTROSPECTION(15); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665a8c -> 0x141666760; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406634ac -> 0x1416602a0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Why would I waste time thinking about myself?

column2: value_type=INTROSPECTION(15); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665aa6 -> 0x1416666b0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406634c6 -> 0x1416602d0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some time spent in reflection is admirable, but you must not forget to live your life.

column2: value_type=SELF_CONTROL(16); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665ac5 -> 0x141666708; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406634e5 -> 0x141661a98; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I think self-control is key.  Master yourself.

column2: value_type=SELF_CONTROL(16); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665ae4 -> 0x141666610; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663504 -> 0x141661ac8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Why deny yourself your heart's desire?

column2: value_type=SELF_CONTROL(16); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665afe -> 0x141666640; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066351e -> 0x141661a00; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: People should be able to control themselves, but it's fine to follow impulses that aren't too harmful.

column2: value_type=TRANQUILITY(17); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665b1d -> 0x141666d58; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066353d -> 0x141661a68; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The mind thinks best when the world is at rest.

column2: value_type=TRANQUILITY(17); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665b3c -> 0x141666d88; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066355c -> 0x141661990; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Give me the bustle and noise over all that quiet!

column2: value_type=TRANQUILITY(17); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665b56 -> 0x141666ce8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663576 -> 0x1416619c8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I like a balance of tranquility and commotion myself.

column2: value_type=HARMONY(18); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665b75 -> 0x141666d20; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663595 -> 0x141661918; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We should all be as one.  Why all the struggling?

column2: value_type=HARMONY(18); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665b94 -> 0x141666c50; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406635b4 -> 0x141661950; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We grow through debate and struggle, even chaos and discord.

column2: value_type=HARMONY(18); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665bae -> 0x141666c90; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406635ce -> 0x1416618b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some discord is a healthy part of society, but we must also try to live together.

column2: value_type=MERRIMENT(19); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665c0b -> 0x141666c10; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066362b -> 0x141661838; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's great when we all get a chance to be merry together.

column2: value_type=MERRIMENT(19); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665c25 -> 0x141666c00; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663645 -> 0x141661908; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Be merry!

column2: value_type=MERRIMENT(19); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665c7c -> 0x141666be8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066369c -> 0x1416617c8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Merriment is worthless.

column2: value_type=MERRIMENT(19); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665c96 -> 0x141666bb8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406636b6 -> 0x141661878; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Bah!  I hope you aren't celebrating something.

column2: value_type=MERRIMENT(19); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665cb0 -> 0x141666b20; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406636d0 -> 0x1416617e0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I can take or leave merrymaking myself, but I don't begrudge people their enjoyment.

column2: value_type=CRAFTSMANSHIP(20); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665cc9 -> 0x141666b78; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406636e9 -> 0x141661768; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: An artisan, their materials and the tools to shape them!

column2: value_type=CRAFTSMANSHIP(20); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665ce8 -> 0x141666ab0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663708 -> 0x1416617a8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Masterwork?  Why should I care?

column2: value_type=CRAFTSMANSHIP(20); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665d02 -> 0x141666ad0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663722 -> 0x141661f30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: A tool should get the job done, but one shouldn't obsess over the details.

column2: value_type=MARTIAL_PROWESS(21); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665d21 -> 0x141666a20; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663741 -> 0x141661f80; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: A skilled warrior is a beautiful sight to behold.

column2: value_type=MARTIAL_PROWESS(21); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665d40 -> 0x141666a60; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663760 -> 0x141661e60; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Why this obsession with weapons and battle?  I don't understand some people.

column2: value_type=MARTIAL_PROWESS(21); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665d5a -> 0x141666160; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066377a -> 0x141661eb0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The world isn't always safe.  I can see the value in martial training, the beauty even, but it shouldn't be exalted.

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665db7 -> 0x1416660b0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406637d7 -> 0x141661e10; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The amount of practice that goes into mastering a skill is so impressive.

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665dd1 -> 0x1416661d8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406637f1 -> 0x141661dd0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We should all be so lucky as to truly master a skill.

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665e28 -> 0x141666000; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663848 -> 0x141661da0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: All of that practice is misspent effort.

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665e42 -> 0x141666100; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663862 -> 0x141661d40; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Everyone should broaden their horizons.  Any work beyond learning the basics is just a waste.

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665e94 -> 0x141665f60; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406638b4 -> 0x141661cd0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's more to life than becoming great at just one thing, but being good at several isn't bad!

column2: value_type=SKILL(22); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665eae -> 0x141666030; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406638ce -> 0x141661c50; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I think people should hone their skills, but it's possible to take it too far and lose sight of the breadth of life.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665f13 -> 0x141665f10; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663933 -> 0x141661b70; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: The best way to get what you want out of life is to work for it.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665f2d -> 0x141665ed8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x14066394d -> 0x141661c18; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Hard work is the true sign of character.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665f47 -> 0x141665fc8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663967 -> 0x141661be0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: In life, you should work hard.  Then work harder.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665fac -> 0x141665df0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406639cc -> 0x141661b30; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Hard work is bested by luck, connections and wealth every time.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665fc6 -> 0x141665ea0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x1406639e6 -> 0x141661af0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You shouldn't whittle your life away on working.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140665fe0 -> 0x141665e78; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663a00 -> 0x141661bb8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's foolish to work hard for anything.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066603c -> 0x141665da0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663a5c -> 0x141661270; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Hard work is great.  Finding a way to work half as hard is even better.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666056 -> 0x141665d50; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663a76 -> 0x141661340; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I only work so hard, but sometimes you have to do what you have to do.

column2: value_type=HARD_WORK(23); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666070 -> 0x141665e30; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663a90 -> 0x1416612f0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: An earnest effort at any required tasks.  That's all that's needed.

column2: value_type=SACRIFICE(24); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666089 -> 0x1416665a8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663aa9 -> 0x1416612b8; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: We must be ready to sacrifice when the time comes.

column2: value_type=SACRIFICE(24); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406660a8 -> 0x1416665e0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663ac8 -> 0x1416611d0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Why harm yourself for anybody else's benefit?

column2: value_type=SACRIFICE(24); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406660c2 -> 0x1416664f0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663ae2 -> 0x141661200; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Some self-sacrifice is worthy, but do not forget yourself in devotion to the well-being of others.

column2: value_type=COMPETITION(25); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406660e1 -> 0x141666560; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b01 -> 0x141661150; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's a competitive world, and you'd be a fool to think otherwise.

column2: value_type=COMPETITION(25); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666100 -> 0x141666470; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b20 -> 0x141661198; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: All of this striving against one another is so foolish.

column2: value_type=COMPETITION(25); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066611a -> 0x1416664a8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b3a -> 0x1416610f0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There is value in a good rivalry, but such danger as well.

column2: value_type=PERSEVERANCE(26); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666139 -> 0x1416663f8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b59 -> 0x141661130; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Keep going and never quit.

column2: value_type=PERSEVERANCE(26); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666158 -> 0x141666420; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b78 -> 0x141661040; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Anybody that sticks to something a moment longer than they have to is an idiot.

column2: value_type=PERSEVERANCE(26); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666172 -> 0x141666340; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663b92 -> 0x141661090; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's good to keep pushing forward, but sometimes you just have to know when it's time to stop.

column2: value_type=LEISURE_TIME(27); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406661cf -> 0x1416662f8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663bef -> 0x141661018; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's best to slow down and just relax.

column2: value_type=LEISURE_TIME(27); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406661e9 -> 0x1416663a0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663c09 -> 0x141660fc0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Wouldn't it be grand to just take my life off and do nothing for the rest of my days?

column2: value_type=LEISURE_TIME(27); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666240 -> 0x141666278; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663c60 -> 0x141660f90; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Time spent in leisure is such a waste.

column2: value_type=LEISURE_TIME(27); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066625a -> 0x141666320; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663c7a -> 0x141660f70; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's work to be done!

column2: value_type=LEISURE_TIME(27); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666274 -> 0x1416662a0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663c94 -> 0x1416616e0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's some value in leisure, but one also has to engage with other aspects of life.

column2: value_type=COMMERCE(28); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066628d -> 0x141666210; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663cad -> 0x141661738; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Trade is the life-blood of a thriving society.

column2: value_type=COMMERCE(28); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406662ac -> 0x141666240; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663ccc -> 0x141661628; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: All of this buying and selling isn't honest work.

column2: value_type=COMMERCE(28); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406662c6 -> 0x141667540; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663ce6 -> 0x141661660; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's something to be said for trade as a necessity, but there are better things in life to do with one's time.

column2: value_type=ROMANCE(29); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406662e5 -> 0x1416675b8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d05 -> 0x1416615b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: There's nothing like a great romance!

column2: value_type=ROMANCE(29); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666304 -> 0x1416674a0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d24 -> 0x1416615e0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: These people carrying on about romance should be more practical.

column2: value_type=ROMANCE(29); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066631e -> 0x1416674f0; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d3e -> 0x141661530; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: You shouldn't get too carried away with romance, but it's fine in moderation.

column2: value_type=NATURE(30); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066633d -> 0x141667418; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d5d -> 0x141661580; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: It's wonderful to be out exploring the wilds!

column2: value_type=NATURE(30); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066635c -> 0x141667450; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d7c -> 0x141661460; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: I could do without all of those creatures and that tangled greenery.

column2: value_type=NATURE(30); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x140666376 -> 0x141667370; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663d96 -> 0x1416614b0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Nature can be enjoyed and used for myriad purposes, but there must always be respect and even fear of its power.

column2: value_type=PEACE(31); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x14066639b -> 0x1416673e8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663dbb -> 0x141661400; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: Let there be peace throughout the world.

column2: value_type=PEACE(31); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406663ba -> 0x1416672d8; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663dda -> 0x141661430; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: How I long for the beautiful spectacle of war!

column2: value_type=PEACE(31); reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000 owner 0x140664be0 load 0x1406663d4 -> 0x141667310; classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000 owner 0x140662600 load 0x140663df4 -> 0x1416613a0; complete switch source announcement-conversation/*-dialogue-102b390.c; no quotation wrapper
column3: War is sometimes necessary, but peace must be valued as well, when we can have it.
